info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Zeolite Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation of detailed entries for the Zeolite Recliner in the product catalog. It allows businesses to manage specifications, features, and attributes associated with the reclining chair, enhancing the visibility and information available to potential customers. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and product information management tools that require up-to-date and detailed product descriptions. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure their product offerings are comprehensive and competitive in the market.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for the Zeolite recliner, ensuring all necessary specifications and attributes are included for accurate representation and functionality.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for the Zeolite Recliner. It contains the specifications and configurations required for processing the recliner details through the API.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority or not.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the zeolite recliner.
